We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have a template (id 29646) that seems to deprotect TBS? Actually template 29646 is a TBS deprotection? The retro_smarts: [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]... So it breaks O-Si bond, forming alcohol. So step 1 (retro) could be removal of TBS protecting group to give a free alcohol. The product of applying template gave three possible precursors: each with TBS attached at different OH? The product is target; precursors are TBS-protected versions of each OH? The three precursors: 
1) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO
2) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C
3) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO

So target has three OH groups: one on the cyclic acetal? Actually there is an OH on the ring (primary?), one on side chain (allylic alcohol?), and a carboxylic acid at end. The TBS likely protecting the primary alcohol? The template suggests TBS removal yields free OH. So we can choose one of the precursors as previous step where that OH was protected.

We need total 5 steps. Likely steps: 1) deprotect TBS (retro). 2) formation of the carboxylic acid via HWE (Still-Gennari) from aldehyde and phosphonate. 3) reduction of ester to aldehyde via DIBAL-H. 4) maybe formation of the side chain double bonds via HWE from aldehyde and phosphonate (E-selective). 5) maybe formation of the cyclic core via intramolecular cyclization? Or maybe start from simpler building blocks: a cyclohexane diol protected, then attach side chain via HWE, then deprotect, then oxidation to acid.

We need to find templates for each transformation. Use search to find templates for HWE (formation of C=C from aldehyde + phosphonate). Search functional_groups_broken: ["aldehydes"], formed: ["C-C double bonds"] maybe. Already tried and got none. Maybe need to specify functional_groups_formed: ["C-C double bonds"] and broken: ["aldehydes"] but no results. Could try functional_groups_broken: ["aldehydes"], formed: ["carboxylic esters"]? Already none.

Maybe use template for oxidation of alcohol to aldehyde? Search broken: ["aliphatic hydroxyls"], formed: ["aldehydes"].
